_comment: Site-wide config. Anything null is intentionally unset — see RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md. SITE_URL env var (or Netlify's URL) overrides siteUrl at build time.
title: BarberRome | Bay Area Rapper | Vallejo & San Francisco

forms._modes: netlify = Netlify Forms (default, no server code). function = POST JSON to /.netlify/functions/subscribe which relays to SUBSCRIBE_WEBHOOK_URL / BOOKING_WEBHOOK_URL.

analytics._note: Events always go to window.dataLayer. Paste a provider snippet into src/partials/analytics.html if you want one.
